stem:
The line graphed on the coordinate grid can be used to determine the number of inches of water added to a swimming pool after different numbers of hours.

Which statement best describes the slope of the graphed line?

options.label: F
options.text: The water is being added at a rate of 0.42 inch per hour.

options.label: G
options.text: The water is being added at a rate of 0.80 inch per hour.

options.label: H
options.text: The water is being added at a rate of 2.40 inches per hour.

options.label: J
options.text: The water is being added at a rate of 1.25 inches per hour.

visual_elements: A coordinate grid titled Swimming Pool with x-axis labeled 'Number of Hours' from 0 to 10 and y-axis labeled 'Water Added (inches)' from 0 to 30, with a line rising from origin (0,0) to (10, 30)
